title: 语言模型何时信任自己？同模型自验证作为条件置信信号
summary: 研究评估了同模型自验证作为选择性预测的置信信号，与LL-AVG和LL-SUM基线比较。结果高度依赖任务和模型：在ARC-Challenge上自验证对Phi-2和Qwen模型有显著提升，但在TruthfulQA-MC上不可靠。自验证应视为条件置信信号，而非通用不确定性估计器。
summary_en: Evaluates same-model self-verification as a confidence signal for selective prediction against LL-AVG and LL-SUM baselines. Results are task- and model-dependent: improves on ARC-Challenge for Phi-2 and Qwen, but unreliable on TruthfulQA-MC. Self-verification is a conditional signal, not a general-purpose uncertainty estimator.
